crossref.title: First principles methods using CASTEP
crossref.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
               <jats:p>The CASTEP code for first principles electronic structure calculations will be described. A brief, non-technical overview will be given and some of the features and capabilities highlighted. Some features which are unique to CASTEP will be described and near-future development plans outlined.</jats:p>
